name: context overview
wording: an account of one bounded context computed from the concept journal and the ledger, never written by hand: its subject and place in the context map, then its concepts as plain prose, whole before parts, the concept no other is built from first and every other after a concept built from it, then its open decisions and the cuts in flight on it; it is read first at every reconstitution, so a session meets the design as one whole before its parts.
reason: Reconstitution cut (0076), part 1: a fresh session met about sixty separate concepts and no whole account, and could not tell which cuts were in flight.
